python3 - <<'PY'
import os
os.chdir('/Users/guillaumeloulier/PhpstormProjects/oss/elephc/.claude/worktrees/streams-csv-signature')
p='src/codegen_support/runtime/resources/filter.rs'
s=open(p).read()
old='''    emitter.instruction("mov rax, QWORD PTR [rbp - 8]");                        // buffer pointer
    emitter.instruction("mov rdx, QWORD PTR [rbp - 16]");                       // current length
    emitter.instruction("mov rcx, r11");                                        // built-in filter id
    emitter.instruction("call __rt_apply_stream_filter");                       // transform in place; rdx = new length'''
new='''    emitter.instruction("mov rdi, rax");                                        // the node whose parameters apply
    emitter.instruction("mov QWORD PTR [rbp - 32], r11");                       // the filter id outlives the publish
    emitter.instruction("call __rt_asf_params_load");                           // the encoders read them from globals
    emitter.instruction("mov rax, QWORD PTR [rbp - 8]");                        // buffer pointer
    emitter.instruction("mov rdx, QWORD PTR [rbp - 16]");                       // current length
    emitter.instruction("mov rcx, QWORD PTR [rbp - 32]");                       // built-in filter id
    emitter.instruction("call __rt_apply_stream_filter");                       // transform in place; rdx = new length'''
assert s.count(old)==1
s=s.replace(old,new)
open(p,'w').write(s)
print('x86 chain publishes each node')
